verdict.rationale: AgentMail is developer infrastructure for provisioning email inboxes for AI agents (bulk inbox creation, sending/receiving, webhooks, MCP/CLI integrations), not a consumer email service offering alias/masked-address privacy protection for a human switcher's sign-ups. There is no evidence of a masking/forwarding feature that hides a user's real personal address from websites or strangers — the product's inboxes are agent-owned mailboxes, not privacy aliases for an individual's real inbox.
